Q: etcd for HA Patroni/Postgres - etcd user/password authentication A:

I figured out from the patroni docs that you can make etcd username/pw known to Patroni by using the environment variables

  1. PATRONI_ETCD_USERNAME &

  2. PATRONI_ETCD_PASSWORD

Q: changing ttkboostrap button style A:

Some time has passed, but I had the same question.
Here is my minimal verification that shows that it works:

import ttkbootstrap as ttk

app = ttk.Window(themename="darkly")

# Create two buttons WITHOUT bootstyle
btn1 = ttk.Button(app, text="Button 1")
btn2 = ttk.Button(app, text="Button 2")

btn1.pack(padx=12, pady=8)
btn2.pack(padx=12, pady=8)

# Later: change bootstyle of only the second button
btn2.configure(bootstyle="success outline")  # applied after creation

app.mainloop()
# if/because configuring bootsyle works there are two DIFFERENT styled buttons visible

Q: why do need multiple from clauses in a docker file? A:

In short, because by scripting the build process as much as possible, it becomes repeatable. You can absolutely build your application on the host machine and copy the executable into an image using a smaller Dockerfile. But then you can run into issues when you have a different Linux distribution on the host than in the image and the libraries don't match. Or one developer has a different setup than another, leading to differences depending on who built the application.
